section_summary.extract_value: This section reports correlations between Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) factors and BMI. General Body Appreciation showed a significant negative correlation with BMI (r = -.24), while Body Image Investment did not correlate with BMI (r = .03). The General Body Appreciation correlation remained significant when age was controlled for.
